entries.title: The Battle for Mount Hyjal
body: The last and bloodiest battle of the Third War, kept in the Caverns of Time. By the time the Legion reached Mount Hyjal, it had broken every nation of the Eastern Kingdoms and slain the Wild Gods of Kalimdor, Cenarius among them. Archimonde came to take the power of the second Well of Eternity beneath the World Tree, Nordrassil.
Night elves, the Alliance and the new Horde stood together on the mountain. They could not hold the Legion forever. They only had to buy Malfurion Stormrage time.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg: Battle of Mount Hyjal (introduction, Prelude: the Third War)

entries.title: The Alliance Base
body: Jaina Proudmoore's camp on the lower slopes, held by the survivors she led across the sea from Lordaeron. The Scourge comes at it first, wave after wave.

entries.title: The Horde Encampment
body: Thrall's camp further up the mountain, where the orcs who once served the Legion now stand against it.

entries.title: Nordrassil
body: The World Tree at the summit, and beneath it the Well of Eternity that Illidan made ten thousand years ago. Tyrande Whisperwind and her Sentinels hold the night elf village at its roots for the last stand.

entries.title: Rage Winterchill
body: A lich who, unlike most of his kind, was fanatically loyal to the Burning Legion rather than the Lich King. He led the Scourge against the defenders' bases.

entries.title: Anetheron
body: A dreadlord, Archimonde's emissary to Tichondrius, set to watch over the Lich King. He grew uneasy as the dreadlords began to suspect Ner'zhul of treachery. When Kel'Thuzad summoned Archimonde, Anetheron came as his guard, and led the Scourge up the mountain.

entries.title: Kaz'rogal
body: A lieutenant of Archimonde who struck at the orcs' base. No history of the war remembers him.

entries.title: Azgalor
body: A pit lord who climbed the mountain beside Archimonde after Mannoroth's death, leading demons and undead against the defenders.

entries.title: Archimonde
body: Once one of the three rulers of the eredar on Argus, with Kil'jaeden and Velen. Where most eredar joined Sargeras for knowledge, Archimonde joined for power. He became the Dark Titan's right hand: heartless, brutal, cunning and far-sighted.

At the summit, Malfurion called an army of wisps that set off the World Tree's enchantments in a vast explosion, and Archimonde was destroyed. It was the Legion's greatest defeat since the War of the Ancients.
